_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: gamma-Poisson (NB2) with rate ratio 0.7 and theta 2

agreement.claim: both engines report the same log rate ratio, standard error, interval and theta
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: up to 1.2e-8 (theta). harness/regression_examples.test.py checks the estimate against a direct BFGS maximization of the NB2 likelihood, and shows a Poisson fit's SE (0.061) and a NegativeBinomial family at its default alpha = 1 (0.090) are both different from the estimated-dispersion SE (0.079).

recovery.claim: the log rate ratio and theta are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Theta is estimated imprecisely at any realistic size. At 600 people the log rate ratio's miss (0.24) left little room below the effect of 0.36; the fixture uses 1000.
